def debug_json(text):
    # Rust Debug strings use \0 and \u{...} in addition to JSON escapes.
    # Consume escaped backslashes as pairs so a literal "\\u{...}" is retained.
    out=[];at=0
    while at<len(text):
        if text[at]!='\\' or at+1==len(text): out.append(text[at]);at+=1;continue
        code=text[at+1]
        if code=='0': out.append('\\u0000');at+=2
        elif code=='u' and text[at+2:at+3]=='{':
            end=text.index('}',at+3);out.append(json.dumps(chr(int(text[at+3:end],16)))[1:-1]);at=end+1

import hashlib,re,subprocess
def resolve_symbol(binary):
    lines=subprocess.run(['nm','--defined-only','--no-demangle',binary],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True).stdout.splitlines()
    raw=[line.split()[-1]for line in lines if line.split()and 'with_limits'in line.split()[-1]]
    decoded=subprocess.run(['c++filt','--format=rust'],input='\n'.join(raw)+'\n',capture_output=True,text=True,check=True).stdout.splitlines()
    assert len(raw)==len(decoded),'demangler changed cardinality'
    def canonical(name):
        name=re.sub(r'\[[0-9a-f]+\]','',name)
        name=re.sub(r'::h[0-9a-f]+$','',name)
        inherent=re.fullmatch(r'<([^<>]+)>::with_limits',name)
        return inherent.group(1)+'::with_limits'if inherent else name
    pairs=[dict(raw=a,demangled=b)for a,b in zip(raw,decoded)if canonical(b)=='nts_core::hir::memory::Analysis::with_limits']
    assert len(pairs)==1,('expected one actual analysis symbol',pairs)
    return dict(binary_sha256=hashlib.sha256(open(binary,'rb').read()).hexdigest(),**pairs[0])
